_approach: The Producer School's Black Coffee recipe: a clean deep kick with a low tom loop pulsing in 8ths underneath (low end rolled off so it never fights the sub), a single realistic mid-tom shot on the even bar, a noisy velocity-shaped shaker, a soft rim backbeat and one wood shot with reverb. Ref: Black Coffee 'Drive' (2018), 'Your Eyes' (2017). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
